rules.catalogue: a clause that holds 'catalogue entries' for OxFunc's surface_dispatch.rs: each FUNC_ID constant's modules from its arg_preparation_profile arm (or its imported eval_<name>_surface), their files in the crate's module tree, the files those use through crate, self, super, sibling-crate and child-module paths and the files they declare (not through the dispatch file), every test of the crate (attributed to the IDs it names) and the files sources include literally or name; all pinned for every citing bead

categories.corpus: a path component in ["fixtures", "corpus", "testdata", "golden", "evidence"] or an extension in ["tsv", "csv", "xlsx", "xlsm", "xlsb", "xls"]
categories.function-family: files resolved from the catalogue, and files under [("OxFunc", "crates/oxfunc_core/src/functions/")]
categories.oracle-runner: files reached through a source-discovery path, and files under [("OxFunc", "smart-fuzzer/"), ("OxFunc", "tools/xll-addin/"), ("DnaTreeCalc", "src/dnacalc-conform/")]
categories.order: corpus first, then source-discovery files as oracle-runner, then markdown files as other, then parser, function-family and oracle-runner
categories.other: markdown files outside the corpus and the discovery paths, and every file no other category names
categories.parser: files under [("OxFml", "crates/oxfml_core/src/syntax/"), ("OxFml", "crates/oxfml_core/src/language_service/")] and tests resolved for them

rules.code_refs: for every Rust input whose read disposition is port or reference: the files of its repository that its non-test code refers to (refs) and includes literally with include!, include_str! or include_bytes! (includes), the include macros of its non-test code whose argument is not one string literal (unread_includes: a concat! or a macro variable, which this pin does not expand; each such file is counted once in summary.resolution_skipped), the library crates of other legacy repositories it refers to by crate name (crates, as '<Repo> crate <name>'; a crate of its own repository with the same name wins, and a name two other repositories define is not followed), the run-time loads it makes (runtime: fs::read, fs::read_to_string, fs::read_dir, File::open, OpenOptions and Command::new, whose targets are not resolved), and what its test code adds (test_refs, test_includes, test_unread_includes, test_crates, test_runtime). A file of a library crate's module tree resolves crate, self, super and sibling-crate paths and relative paths to its child modules; any other file of a package (an integration test, a binary, an example, a bench or a build script) resolves only paths into the library crates by crate name. A path names the files of its longest prefix that is a module; a name imported with use and then used as a path prefix resolves only through its use. A file in no package, or one that does not parse, has no code_refs and is counted in summary.resolution_skipped
rules.content_facts: for every input: the lines of its own text that the citation sweep of numeric_content matches (citations: line and pattern, never the line's text), and the commits of the dispositions file's tainted list that changed it (changed_by), as numeric_content.changed_by_rule says
rules.declared_modules: every module a pinned Rust input declares (mod x;, with or without #[path], test-only included) is pinned for the parent's beads with the parent's disposition for each, transitively; via names the parent
rules.directory_tests: for a Port from text that asks for test files: the tests of the cited directory's crate that name its module (<module>::), with the files they include or name
rules.discovery: a token whose own sentence names it a "source-discovery path" is read for behaviour only: its files are inputs with disposition reference (unless quarantined or quarantine_derived) and category oracle-runner (corpus files stay corpus)

dispositions.input: quarantined when any citing bead reads it so, then quarantine_derived, then port when any citing bead may port it, otherwise reference. When the citing beads differ in disposition or in how they reached the input, routes lists each group of beads with its own disposition and via
dispositions.quarantine_derived: not a port source and out of every port count (infra-m0.5 records its numeric provenance): a file of a package whose Cargo.toml enables oxfunc_core's research-x87 feature (on the dependency or through a feature of its own), or a Rust file whose code names excel_numeric::research, the route to the quarantined x87 entry points; catalogue files that call the crate-internal excel_numeric dispatcher keep their disposition and list it under quarantined_helpers
dispositions.quarantined: not a port source: the citing clause holds QUARANTINED, or the path is under [("OxFunc", "crates/oxfunc_core/src/excel_numeric/")] (infra-m0.5 records its numeric provenance)
dispositions.reference: read for behaviour only: the citing clause or the text after the last path holds one of ["behavioural reference", "reference only", "references only", "owner-brief reference", "precedent", "ideas", "lessons", "discovery location", "design candidate", "not authority"], or the token's own sentence names it a "source-discovery path"

rules.excluded: cited in a sentence that says "not port" before the path; recorded with its blob, never an input, and never pinned as a declared module for the excluding beads
rules.exported: for the .rs inputs of a Port from text that asks for symbols, and their declared modules: the pub items of the blob (and of its pub inline modules), test-only items removed
rules.families: the Do list after 'Port the named family only:'; an item that equals a catalogue name resolves to its ID, any other item stays an unresolved term (bead dc-xz2t owns them)
rules.license_status: found when the pinned tree has a root file whose name starts with license, licence, copying or unlicense (case-insensitive); otherwise none-found; never inferred. summary.license_none_found counts the inputs of repositories with none-found
rules.module_tree: a library crate's modules are walked from src/lib.rs through its mod declarations as rustc reads them: #[path] relative to the declaring scope's directory (a #[path] file reads its own children as a mod.rs does), otherwise <name>.rs or <name>/mod.rs beside a mod.rs or crate root, or under <name>/ beside a non-mod-rs file; inline modules add their name
rules.not_pinned: the not_pinned list: paths under these prefixes are never inputs, committed or not; --lookup reports them as bulk evidence with their owner and archive
rules.numeric_provenance: from the dispositions file (migration/numeric-provenance.json; another with --provenance), by the content-derivation rule of 2026-10-15: a module entry for the path when the pinned blob is the reviewed one (another blob makes the input at least unresolved), else a witness_chain entry that clears the path at its pinned blob on the file's own acquisition (cleared_as acquisition) when the file holds a retained witness's expected bits (its source capture or its independent retention; every other witness_chain entry admits its file to the witness chain only and gives no provenance), else the first class whose selector matches, else unresolved (no-review) when the pin quarantines the input; then at least unresolved for a citation sweep match (citation-sweep), a change by a listed tainted commit that no such witness_chain entry names among its considered_commits (tainted-commit) or an include macro the pin cannot read (unread-include); then at least the provenance of every file its code includes literally (include-of-quarantined, to a fixed point). A file that is not an input counts by the entry for its path, or unresolved under the quarantined directory. A file that only refers to a tainted or unresolved file keeps its own provenance and lists, under calls_quarantined (calls-quarantined), the files of its repository it refers to whose provenance is tainted or unresolved, each crate of another repository it refers to that holds such a file, and '<Repo> run-time loads' when its code loads files or runs programs at run time; summary.numeric_provenance counts these edges and the edges into files that are not pinned inputs, which bead dc-4uy4 owns. A catalogue function with quarantined_helpers records each helper's disposition and the most restrictive one. Dispositions are cleared, tainted or unresolved (the file defines them); the read disposition is unchanged by them, but summary.by_disposition counts a port input whose numeric provenance is tainted as port_numeric_tainted, not as port
rules.pin_date: the UTC date on which this pin content was first written; a run that reproduces the content keeps it, and no other time is recorded
rules.pinned_commit: each repository's HEAD at pin time, checked to be a commit object; every blob is read from that commit's tree, never from a working tree
rules.plan_audit: every blob of docs/plan/source-audit.json sources compared with the blob of the same path at the pinned commit; changed_since_plan_audit lists each that differs
rules.release_allowlist: release-source-allowlist.json beside the manifest: every input whose read disposition is port and whose numeric_provenance is absent or cleared, each with its calls_quarantined list when it has one; summary.release_allowlist counts them; --lookup exits 5 for any other input whose numeric provenance is tainted or unresolved, and 6 for an input admitted only with its calls_quarantined list (port it only against clean replacements of the listed modules)
rules.resolution_skips: a file a resolution cannot read (a parse failure, a file in no crate or outside its crate's module tree, a non-literal include macro, an absent, ambiguous or cfg_attr module file) is counted per reason in notes and summary.resolution_skipped; counted fallbacks are in summary.resolution_fallbacks
rules.retained_witnesses: the retained numeric witness selections of the dispositions file, each with its source capture (repository, commit, path, blob, sha256 and rows); --lookup of a source names its retained selection and exits 0. The capture itself is not an input; its selection under migration/witnesses is the copy to read
rules.runner_candidate: a non-markdown input reached through a source-discovery path whose blob holds one of ["Excel.Application", "Workbooks.Open", "Marshal", "Interop", "ComObject"]; infra-m1.2 selects among the runner candidates when it ports the capture adapter; this pin selects none
rules.source: the Port from section of every bead in the tracker; a cited directory expands to its committed files
rules.symbols: code-like words (holding :: or _, or camel-case) of a path's clause and of the text after the last path, plus capitalised single words listed after <path>:; an input (and its declared modules) lists those its blob holds as whole words
rules.tainted_commit_rule: numeric_content.tainted_commit_rule: what the dispositions file's stated rule finds in the history of its repository's pinned commit, computed here from git: identification, the commits git log -i -E --grep=<identification_pattern> lists, and message_sweep, the commits whose message the citation sweep matches. The pin refuses to write when the tainted_commits list omits one of them or a commit the commits review ties to the pass, lists a commit none of them gives, or records found_by or a review verdict they and the review files do not give
rules.unavailable: cited but absent at the pinned commit, or not resolvable to a repository; never an input and never counted among port inputs
rules.verification: provisional for every input: the blob is pinned at a committed object, and nothing here compiled, audited or license-cleared it; bead dc-4r4l's compile audition owns any change of that state
rules.witness_chain: numeric_content.witness_chain: for each witness_chain entry of the dispositions file, the citation sweep's matches in its blob and the commits of the tainted list that git log of its path up to the entry's commit lists (content_facts); the pin refuses to write when the entry's blob is not the path's blob at that commit or the commit is not an ancestor of the pin
rules.working_tree: git status --porcelain with -c core.excludesFile= -c core.autocrlf=true -c core.checkStat=minimal -c core.trustctime=false: only the repository's own ignore rules apply, line endings compare as the Windows checkout wrote them, and unchanged size and time skip a re-read. Reported, not pinned: a blob comes from the commit object

numeric_content.changed_by_rule: the paths each listed commit changed against its first parent (git diff-tree -r --root -M), followed through later renames up to the pinned commit; recorded per input under content_facts.changed_by

citation_sweep.rule: every line of every pinned input's text (lossy UTF-8) that holds a pattern, case-sensitively, not directly after an ASCII letter, digit or underscore; recorded per input under content_facts.citations as line and pattern, never as the line's text

tainted_commit_rule.how: identification: the commits git log -i -E --grep=<identification_pattern> <commit> lists; message_sweep: the commits of git log <commit> whose message holds a pattern of the citation sweep, case-sensitively, not directly after an ASCII letter, digit or underscore
